I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent the list to your DM:

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because the gatehouse kiosks weren't sending SMS bay assignments to drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard. Support patched it that evening.
2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing.

Left out:
- Two other Moss notes mention Quarrendon but have no ticket numbers: the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in.
- Tickets #4409 and #4412 in Moss's Central handoffs digest are for Marrow Fieldworks, not Quarrendon.
- Marcus's "Quarendon Freightways" note is about a different company that isn't a customer.

I only checked the shared team files that you can see yourself.
